emblem_alph.desc: As valuable as it is shiny, this Emblem of Alph enables special skills and abilities.

emblem_cosma.label: Emblem of Cosma
emblem_cosma.desc: More than just a highly cherishable gewgaw, this glistening Emblem of Cosma can confer special powers upon its holder.

emblem_friendly.label: Emblem of Friendly
emblem_friendly.desc: Radiantly important and importantly radiant, this Emblem of Friendly can unlock special talents.

emblem_grendaline.label: Emblem of Grendaline
emblem_grendaline.desc: This lustrous Emblem of Grendaline bestows some fairly impressive abilities upon its lucky owner.

emblem_humbaba.label: Emblem of Humbaba
emblem_humbaba.desc: Behold a dazzling Emblem of Humbaba. Keep it safe, and someday it may entitle you to wield special powers and whatnot.

emblem_lem.label: Emblem of Lem
emblem_lem.desc: Almost blinding in its glory, this Emblem of Lem may allow you to do some seriously fancy things.

emblem_pot.desc: Gleaming as if lit from within, this Emblem of Pot looks like the kind of thing you should hold on to. It may just come in handy down the road, hm?

emblem_zille.desc: Containing a gleam as if from a sense of its own importance, this Zille Emblem is worth holding on to. Why? You'll see.
